_comment: Canonical CI job set (job names, in .github/workflows/ci.yml order). tools/check-required-checks.sh keeps this in lockstep with ci.yml; tools/release-provenance.py verifies a mirror release tag's CI ran every one of these. There is no deploy gate in this repo: the runtime deploy moved to hopmesh/platform with the infra tree, and branch protection requires only the aggregate 'CI gate'.
required_checks: Web + sim (Astro build · scenario-check · link check)
